title: The new minimum changes the buckets
hook: The last extracted key helps organize the keys still waiting.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Heap parent/child ordering and priority comparisons.
doesNotKnow: Redistribute a monotone radix heap when its next minimum advances the bucket reference.

misconception: Bucket placement remains valid when the last extracted key changes.
objective: Redistribute a monotone radix heap when its next minimum advances the bucket reference.

claims.text: Buckets group keys by their highest differing bit from the last extraction. Rebasing the first nonempty bucket creates a zero bucket containing its minimum; monotone insertions must never be below the last extracted key.
